$comment: Machine-readable learner profile. Consumed by the app for gap tracking and plan generation. Narrative version lives in docs/PROFILE.md.

diagnosis.headline: Already above the data engineering band. £100k was never a real target; the working target is £120k.
evidence: Current comp £88,250 base plus 8-10% bonus, roughly £95-97k total
Median UK data engineer ~£70k; lead/principal ~£85-91k — current package sits above that ceiling
Lumilinks withdrew on budget before any technical round: a Lead Data Engineer role unable to reach £90-95k sits below current package
Median remote AI engineer ~£91k; UK seniors £90-150k base
diagnosis.implication: The constraint is the job title, not the employer and not the skill. Repositioning into AI/ML engineering, targeting £120k.

assets.label: MSc Computational Intelligence (Distinction)
assets.note: Neural networks, probabilistic models, optimisation. CNN dissertation. Faculty Student of the Year.

assets.label: Production LLM/agentic tooling in CI
assets.note: Agentic coding assistants and automated downstream impact analysis in GitLab CI at Dunelm. Currently under-positioned on CV.

assets.label: Data platform engineering
assets.note: Snowflake, dbt, AWS, Airflow, Terraform. Single Customer View with point-in-time correctness.

assets.label: Technical communication and teaching
assets.note: 10 years teaching, Head of Computing, staff development. Professionally assessed skill.

assets.label: Technical leadership
assets.note: Managed team of four at Nimbus; leads architectural initiatives at Dunelm.

assets.label: Cross-context breadth
assets.note: Enterprise retail, scaling fintech, consumer startup.

assets.label: Proven ability to retrain
assets.note: Teacher to data scientist via self-funded MSc, completed with Distinction.

assets.label: Proven interview track record
assets.note: Two offers in 2023 including Dunelm. Interviews well at this level. Only weak spot is timed algorithmic rounds.

gaps.label: Self-valuation and negotiation
gaps.note: One clean data point: reported pay as £70-85k when it is £88,250 plus bonus. The £90-95k Lumilinks ask is ambiguous (treated as practice). Track record is strong, so this is about pricing, not ability.

gaps.label: LLM evaluation methodology
gaps.note: Strongest single hiring signal for real LLM experience. Currently one word on the CV. Top technical gap.

gaps.label: Public visibility and portfolio
gaps.note: No public writing or open-source presence. Disproportionately important for remote and US-remote roles.

gaps.label: CV and narrative positioning
gaps.note: Reads as a data engineer who has touched AI; the evidence supports a stronger claim.

gaps.label: Production ML / MLOps
gaps.note: Builds data foundations for models but has not owned a model in production: serving, monitoring, drift, retraining.

gaps.label: Streaming and real-time systems
gaps.note: Partial coverage via Previse real-time banking ingestion. Kafka, CDC, exactly-once semantics not demonstrated at depth.

gaps.label: Algorithmic / LeetCode rounds
gaps.note: General interview performance is a strength: two offers in 2023, comfortable at this level. The narrow weakness is timed algorithmic puzzles - and the best-paying segment (US companies hiring UK-remote) is the most likely to run them.

gaps.label: Software engineering depth
gaps.note: Maintains a production Python risk engine and builds CI tooling. Likely calibration rather than deficit.

calibration_flag.observed: Reported current pay as £70-85k when it is £88,250 plus bonus. Selected every offered weakness despite contrary CV evidence.
calibration_flag.hypothesis: Systematic self-undervaluation in pricing, not in capability.
calibration_flag.impact: Top-priority gap. Costs money in one conversation rather than over a year.

constraints: 150-400 total study hours over the runway — supports one substantial project plus focused study, not three parallel tracks
3.5 years at current employer: narrative needs progression within the role, not just duration
Long career (from 1997) invites age bias in parts of the market; position on judgement and breadth rather than algorithm puzzles
Leaving a known 8-10% bonus means a base-only offer must clear roughly £105k just to break even
open_questions: Which parts of the Dunelm agentic CI work were owned end to end?
Is there appetite for an internal move into an ML platform role as a stepping stone?
Any hard constraints on travel for occasional on-site work?
What is the actual walk-away number? Nothing below ~£105k base breaks even on total comp.
